steps.en: Clone the repo and install Python dependencies
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，装 Python 依赖

steps.en: Download the official 2B ternary model and run the setup script
steps.zh: 下载官方 2B 三值模型，跑环境脚本

steps.en: Converts the weights to the I2_S layout and builds the tuned kernels for your CPU
steps.zh: 把权重转成 I2_S 布局，按你的 CPU 构建调优内核

steps.en: Start a chat loop on the quantized file
steps.zh: 对量化文件启动聊天循环

steps.en: Decodes with lookup-and-add ternary kernels — fast and low-energy on plain x86/ARM CPUs, no GPU
steps.zh: 用查表加法的三值内核解码——x86/ARM CPU 上快且省电，不用 GPU

value.en: A 2.4B ternary LLM chatting on an ordinary laptop CPU — no GPU, with the README's reported multi-x speedup and large energy savings
value.zh: 2.4B 三元模型在普通笔记本 CPU 上跑对话——不用 GPU，拿到 README 宣称的数倍加速与大幅省电

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-28, Build from source: git clone --recursive https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet.git; pip install -r requirements.txt; huggingface-cli download microsoft/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T-gguf --local-dir models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T; python setup_env.py -md models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T -q i2_s
README.md main @ 2026-09-28, Basic usage: python run_inference.py -m models/BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T/ggml-model-i2_s.gguf -p "You are a helpful assistant" -cnv
README.md main @ 2026-09-28: I2_S/TL1/TL2 kernel table; ARM 1.37x-5.07x and x86 2.37x-6.17x speedup, energy 55.4-70.0% / 71.9-82.2% (project's own claims)
